name: debt-consolidation-ramsey-and-entreleadership
description: Debt Consolidation, Ramsey's Baby Steps and Bankruptcy for South Carolina in October 2026: the five tools that share the name consolidation and which two reduce what you owe, balance transfers, personal loans and term math, secured and retirement-funded options, nonprofit debt management plans, settlement, student, medical and tax debt, credit-score effects, South Carolina collection law, Chapter 7 and Chapter 13, Dave Ramsey's 7 Baby Steps and the evidence for and against them, EntreLeadership and solo-LLC mechanics, a decision framework and the questions to ask each professional. General information, not legal, tax or financial advice.
